description: Source code for a video screencast encoder using libvpx, integrated with Mozilla's threading and WebM writing infrastructure.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder::VPXCodec
classes.description: Handles encoding of frames using libvpx, running asynchronously on a dedicated thread.
